description: This Java class handles the command for deleting a GL (General Ledger) closure within the accounting module of the project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and works with 'GLClosureWritePlatformService' to perform the deletion operation upon receiving a command.

classes.name: DeleteGLClosureCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class that processes delete requests for GL closures, annotated with Spring's @Service and custom @CommandType.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the delete operation on the GLClosureWritePlatformService with the entity ID from the command.
